title: Margi language - Wikipedia
text: Margi, also known as Marghi and Marghi Central, is a Chadic language (a branch of Afroasiatic) spoken in Nigeria, Cameroon, and Chad. It is perhaps the best described of the Biu-Mandara branch of that family. Marghi South language and Putai are closely related and sometimes considered dialects of Margi.
